originalAcceptance: 隐藏列、选区显示、全表显示与键盘导航

commonAcceptance.evidence: Model keeps cells, dimensions and auto/fixed identities; range commands affect all selected columns/rows and keep other sheets and filters.
Grid focus and visible destination after hiding; composition and invalid editing block the command; Escape restores the original draft.
Independent hide/show transactions and undo/redo, plus no-op identity checks.
All six write controls disabled in component tests; actual browser read-only check and ordinary/extended navigation tests.
Actual imported XLSX, two download/reopen passes, raw native hidden flags and dimensions plus manual/filter overlap; selected/all show and final reopen.
Atomic invalid-range/all-hidden refusal; invalid metadata import keeps bytes; legacy export hydration does not mutate model or source.

nativeInteroperability.manualFilterOverlap: Ignorable urn:zuvi:office-studio manualHiddenRows attribute; intersected with native hidden flags on import. Ordinary external files without the attribute retain the existing filtered/manual inference. External native unhide removes stale manual markers.
nativeInteroperability.legacyHydration: Source indexes map through structure edits before manual/filter decisions are combined.
nativeInteroperability.autoRowHeight: Automatic export may refresh height caches; manual commands retain the original model height/mode objects.
